referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A dark fitness template. A full-bleed gym photograph sits behind a centered white promise and an orange action. A program grid with six orange icon cards follows, then a dark motivational band, a classes section with a tabbed list and a large class photo, a weekly schedule table, three trainer cards, and a contact form. The typography is a condensed uppercase display with a neutral sans body. Charcoal, white, and orange define the look.
